svg.title: Quicksort calls with a last-element pivot. Each box shows the left part, the pivot, and the right part. On the mixed array [2, 7, 1, 5, 3, 8, 6, 4] the pivot 4 lands in the middle and the tree is 3 levels deep. On the sorted array 1 to 8 every pivot is the maximum, one side is always empty, and the tree is a chain 7 levels deep
